styles.default: The target video is a scene from a photorealistic drama feature film, shot on anamorphic lenses with shallow depth of field, soft motivated lighting, a warm natural color grade and natural film grain. The acting is naturalistic and emotionally truthful, carried by detailed facial expressions, eyes and breathing.

voices.anna: a warm, clear alto voice of an Englishwoman in her forties with a gentle London accent
voices.tom: a deep, steady, warm baritone voice of an Englishman in his fifties with a soft Yorkshire accent
voices.radio: a deep, warm, low adult male radio presenter voice of a man in his forties

anna.name: Anna
anna.desc: a 45-year-old woman with shoulder-length auburn hair and green eyes, wearing a cream knit jumper

tom.name: Tom
tom.desc: a 55-year-old man with short grey hair and a neat grey beard, wearing a navy wool coat

radio.name: the radio presenter
radio.def: The radio presenter is heard only as a voice from the old kitchen radio.

kitchen.name: a farmhouse kitchen at dawn
kitchen.desc: a warm farmhouse kitchen at dawn with a wooden table, a steaming kettle and pale sunlight through a window

kitchen_night.name: the farmhouse kitchen at night
kitchen_night.desc: the same farmhouse kitchen at night, lit only by one warm lamp over the table

scenes.summary: Anna listens to the morning radio.
scenes.sound: Quiet kitchen room tone, a kettle starting to whistle, birdsong outside.
shots: Medium shot of {anna} at the kitchen table holding a mug, the old radio on the windowsill beside her. {anna}'s lips stay pressed together as she listens. {say:radio|says in a deep, low, cheerful man's voice from the radio speaker|Good morning! <breath> It's going to be a beautiful day.}

scenes.summary: Tom comes in and Anna greets him.
scenes.sound: Kitchen room tone, the door opening, footsteps on stone.
shots: Medium two-shot from the side. {tom} steps into the kitchen and {anna} turns her head toward him, her eyes fixed on his face. {tom}'s lips stay pressed together. {say:anna|says warmly, smiling at him|You're up early. <breath> Tea?}
Close-up of {tom} looking at {anna}, a slow smile spreading. {say:tom|says quietly in a low voice, looking at her|I couldn't sleep.}
